author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Combines viewer-requested and privacy-gated automatic translation, then returns bounded results only to the originating platform without retaining message text.
changelog: 4.1.5: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.5, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: combined Manual, Automatic, and Both modes; fixed !translate buenos dias; added automatic source detection through the disclosed Google web option; retained MyMemory as the documented fixed-source fallback; and regenerated the Streamer.bot import. 1.0.0: initial release with configurable language-code and generic commands, documented Twitch reply context, original-author attribution, MyMemory HTTPS translation, platform-aware output splitting, bounded request state, timeouts, per-user/global cooldowns, provider failure handling, and privacy disclosure.

manifest.name: Translate
installationSteps: Install the add-on, choose Manual, Automatic, or Both, then review the provider privacy disclosure.
Import the Translate Streamer.bot package and approve its one Translate Text action.
Manual examples: !translate buenos dias, !translate fr hello, !es hello, or a Twitch reply containing !en.
Automatic mode starts allowlist-only and remains bounded by cooldown, percentage, and per-minute limits.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Only bounded cooldown metadata is retained; message text is never stored.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded manual/automatic selection, provider dispatch, and source-platform response routing.
